exposure: Personal history of allergy (atopic dermatitis, drug allergy, food allergy)
Comorbidities (allergic rhinitis, sinusitis, adenoidal hypertrophy, urticaria)
cohort: 13,877 children aged 14 years and younger in Hangzhou, China
finding: The prevalence of childhood asthma in Hangzhou, China was 4.8%, with risk factors including caesarean birth, personal history of allergy, and concomitant allergic diseases, while exclusive breastfeeding within the first 6 months and keeping animals appeared protective.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with a higher prevalence of asthma in children.
